journal_lines: Cavern with good stalactites. The woodcutter helped prop the ceiling. The miner worked the walls. Good arrangement.
Dripstone cave. Braced the passages and went deep. Paid off.
Shored up the tunnel before going further. Worth the caution.
Careful work in the wet cave. The stone gave back what we put in.
Stalactites tall as small towers. Worked around them. The towers paid no attention.
The drip-drip of the cave kept time for the axe and the pickaxe both.
Wet ceiling. Set props. The props held. The ceiling held. Came home dry, mostly.
Water on the floor, water on the walls, water in the ceiling. Did the work in spite of the water.
